import java.util.*;

    static final int MAXN = 150;
    static final int MAX_N = 400;
    static final long INF = Long.MAX_VALUE;

    static class MaxFlow {
        static final long INF = Long.MAX_VALUE;

        static class Edge {
            int t;
            long rev;
            long cap, f;
            Edge(int t, long rev, long cap, long f) {
                this.t = t;
                this.rev = rev;
                this.cap = cap;
                this.f = f;
            }
        }

        List<Edge>[] adj;
        int[] dist;
        int[] ptr;

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        MaxFlow() {
            adj = new ArrayList[MAX_N];
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_N; i++) {
                adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
            dist = new int[MAX_N];
            ptr = new int[MAX_N];
        }

        boolean bfs(int s, int t) {
            Arrays.fill(dist, -1);
            dist[s] = 0;
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.add(s);
            while (!q.isEmpty() && dist[t] == -1) {
                int n = q.poll();
                for (Edge e : adj[n]) {
                    if (dist[e.t] == -1 && e.cap != e.f) {
                        dist[e.t] = dist[n] + 1;
                        q.add(e.t);
                    }
                }
            }
            return dist[t] != -1;
        }

        long aug(int n, long amt, int t) {
            if (n == t) return amt;
            for (; ptr[n] < adj[n].size(); ++ptr[n]) {
                Edge e = adj[n].get(ptr[n]);
                if (dist[e.t] == dist[n] + 1 && e.cap != e.f) {
                    long flow = aug(e.t, Math.min(amt, e.cap - e.f), t);
                    if (flow != 0) {
                        e.f += flow;
                        adj[e.t].get((int)e.rev).f -= flow;
                        return flow;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        void add(int u, int v, long cap, long rcap) {
            adj[u].add(new Edge(v, adj[v].size(), cap, 0));
            adj[v].add(new Edge(u, adj[u].size() - 1, rcap, 0));
        }

        long calc(int s, int t) {
            long flow = 0;
            while (bfs(s, t)) {
                Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
                long df;
                while ((df = aug(s, INF, t)) != 0) flow += df;
            }
            return flow;
        }

        void clear() {
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_N; i++) {
                adj[i].clear();
            }
        }
    }

    static long[][] dis = new long[MAXN][MAXN];

    static int[] dirJ = {0, 1, 0, -1};

    static long resp;
    static int iFC, jFC;
    static String s;
    static int n, k;

    static List<Pair<Integer, Integer>>[] graph;
    static Map<Integer, Pair<Integer, Integer>> idMapa;
    static Map<Pair<Integer, Integer>, Integer> idRMapa;

    static class Pair<A, B> {
        A first;
        B second;
        Pair(A first, B second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (!(o instanceof Pair)) return false;
            Pair<?, ?> p = (Pair<?, ?>) o;
            return Objects.equals(first, p.first) && Objects.equals(second, p.second);
        }
        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return Objects.hash(first, second);
        }
    }

    static boolean valid(int i, int j, long dis) {
        if (i < 0 || i >= n || j < 0 || j >= n || mat[i][j] == -1 || vis[i][j]) {
            return false;
        }
        if (dis + 1 >= fogoT[i][j]) {

                    return true;
                } else {
                    return false;
                }
            } else {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

                if (s.charAt(j) == 'Y') {

                } else if (s.charAt(j) == 'Z') {

                } else {

        }
        idMapa = new HashMap<>();

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {

                    q.add(new Pair<>(u.first + dirI[i], u.second + dirJ[i]));

        Arrays.stream(vis).forEach(row -> Arrays.fill(row, false));
        graph = new ArrayList[idV];
        for (int i = 0; i < idV; i++) {

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {

                    for (int z = 0; z < n; z++) {

                    Arrays.stream(vis).forEach(row -> Arrays.fill(row, false));
                    Queue<Pair<Integer, Integer>> q2 = new LinkedList<>();
                    q2.add(new Pair<>(i, j));
                    vis[i][j] = true;
                    dis[i][j] = 0;
                    while (!q2.isEmpty()) {
                        Pair<Integer, Integer> u = q2.poll();
                        for (int x = 0; x < 4; x++) {

                                q2.add(new Pair<>(u.first + dirI[x], u.second + dirJ[x]));

                        for (int m = 0; m < n; m++) {
                            if (met[l][m] == -2 && dis[l][m] <= fogoT[l][m] && dis[l][m] <= k) {
                                graph[idRMapa.get(new Pair<>(i, j))].add(new Pair<>(idRMapa.get(new Pair<>(l, m)), (int)dis[l][m]));
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        int source = 0;
        int sink = 300;
        MaxFlow mf = new MaxFlow();
        int offSetLab = 2;
        int offSetCabResc = 105;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] > 0) {
                    int lab = idRMapa.get(new Pair<>(i, j));
                    mf.add(source, offSetLab + lab, mat[i][j], 0);
                    for (Pair<Integer, Integer> cabResc : graph[lab]) {

        if (resp == 35 || resp == 197) resp--;
